title: What is known, what must be tested
lead: Separate optical feasibility and chip design from evidence of a working sensor.
description: The available summary documents research directions but does not provide an approved public performance dataset.

sections.title: What the material supports
paragraphs: The supplied research discusses optical sensing, spectral interpretation and a photonic glucose chip-design example. These are grounds for further experiments, not a quantified accuracy claim.

sections.title: Open questions
paragraphs: Signal specificity, reference stability, repeatability across conditions, integrated-component behavior and relevance to human use remain to be established.

sections.title: A practical validation path
paragraphs: Controlled measurements could characterize individual components, followed by calibrated prototypes and independently reviewed studies appropriate to the intended application.
